title: Can't Win With You!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Country boy Yuuhi inherits mountain land he meant for a soccer field, but his brother's elite all-boys Shuuiku Academy moves its campus there, making him both landlord and student. The relocated students resent him, and some start eyeing him romantically in ways that make him uncomfortable (Juné blurb via MU). Three-volume dorm comedy; MU lists Rape, Attempted Rape and Blackmail.
life_message: Staying cheerful and stubborn in a hostile new school eventually wins people over.
